title: Orchestration control (OC)
subtitle: Configure the governed request pipeline and the single egress gateway.
loadFailed: Could not load the OC configuration
stale: The configuration was changed by someone else. Refresh and try again.
pending: An OC change is awaiting approval.
leaveBody: You have unsaved OC changes that will be lost.
publishFirst: Publish the agent first, then submit OC changes.
noChanges: The OC draft matches the live version.
approvalRequired: Approval required: once approved it goes live as a new agent version containing only the OC changes. If rejected the draft is kept.
approvalOff: No approval flow is configured: it takes effect immediately and contains only the OC changes.
replaceBody: An OC change is already pending. Withdraw it and submit the current draft?
pipelineSubtitle: Every message goes through this governed path.
denied: You do not have permission to view orchestration.
draftDiffers: The OC draft differs from the live version and has not been submitted.
inSync: The OC draft matches the live version.

glossary.hint: The agent glossary adjusts the platform industry and tenant glossaries. At runtime, aliases expand the search query and the definitions of matched terms go into the prompt.
glossary.useTenantHint: When off, only this agent's own terms are used.
glossary.hiddenCount: {{count}} inherited terms removed for this agent
glossary.inheritedNotice: This term is inherited. Saving makes it an override for this agent; upper layers are unchanged.
glossary.hideBody: “{{name}}” will be hidden for this agent; upper layers are unaffected. Use “Restore all” to bring it back.

rewrite.hint: Rewriting is used for routing and retrieval only; the conversation keeps the user's original text. If it times out (1.5 s) or fails, the original question is used.
rewrite.enableHint: When off, the original question goes straight to routing; alias expansion is unaffected.
rewrite.modelHint: Only chat models enabled for this tenant can be chosen.
rewrite.lowConfidence: Only rewrite when intent confidence is low
rewrite.lowConfidenceHint: Routing decides by confidence; when off, every question is rewritten.
rewrite.coreferenceHint: Replace “it / this” with the object from earlier turns.
rewrite.normalizeHint: Turn casual wording into standard phrasing.
rewrite.decomposeHint: Split several questions in one sentence and retrieve each.
rewrite.translateHint: Translate the question into a target language before retrieval.
rewrite.customHint: Appended to the rewrite instructions, up to 2000 characters.
rewrite.testHint: Try a question with the current unsaved settings. Only changed steps are shown; this makes one debug call.
rewrite.testPlaceholder: e.g. How do I return this SKU?

failure.timeout: Rewrite timed out; the original question was used.
failure.error: The rewrite call failed; the original question was used.
failure.invalid: The rewrite result could not be parsed; the original question was used.
